items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: the poems like Danny Ball. You know, they don't get down and phrase, you know.

ctx.x: That's the first thing you learn when you play music, all that noise. Mm-hmm.

To play music, you've got a phrase. Mm-hmm. You know, bring your notes up and down. You know, make it music-wise. I noticed that with these jazz bands around here. They still go loud, but maybe because they call them the public, you know, the poems like Danny Ball. You know, they don't get down and phrase, you know. Like Orenham used to do in the old days. Mm-hmm. Buddy Petit had a little band here. Oh, the Friar, when I was a kid coming up and said, you know, I was a kid. I don't ever say, man, I joined. That…
